summary: This note documents the budget method <budget_name>!SET_NOTIFICATION_MUTE_FLAG, which turns email notifications for a budget on or off. It gives the syntax, a TRUE/FALSE argument (default FALSE), the return message, access control requirements for custom and account budgets, and two CALL examples. The method is noted as unavailable for Trial Accounts.
one_line: Reference for the budget method that enables or disables email notifications via a TRUE/FALSE mute flag.
key_facts: The method <budget_name>!SET_NOTIFICATION_MUTE_FLAG sets the notification mute flag for a budget.
The single argument accepts TRUE or FALSE.
The default value of the argument is FALSE.
The method returns the message 'The notification mute flag has been updated to <true | false>.'
For custom budgets, executing the method requires a role granted the USAGE privilege on the database and schema that contains the budget instance.
The method is not available for Trial Accounts.
The related method <budget_name>!GET_NOTIFICATION_INTEGRATION_NAME is listed under See also.
Example: CALL budget_db.budget_schema.my_budget!SET_NOTIFICATION_MUTE_FLAG(TRUE); disables email notifications for budget my_budget in schema budget_db.budget_schema.
Example: CALL snowflake.local.account_root_budget!SET_NOTIFICATION_MUTE_FLAG(FALSE); enables email notifications for the account budget.
The account budget has its own access control requirements, covered by application roles described in the budgets guide.
